title: read-only-api-single-write-path
rationale: API is read-only for safety. POST /feedback is the only write path; it appends to JSONL and never mutates the in-memory index or reference data.

description: CIV_CERT/CIV_KEY empty strings caused IsADirectoryError in uvicorn SSL loader because Path('') resolves to Path('.') which is truthy.
resolution: Check the env var string (os.environ.get(...) or '') before constructing Path; treat empty strings as unset and fall through to dev-cert generation.

name: importlib-resources-bundled-data
description: Reference data is loaded via importlib.resources so the API works from an installed wheel, not just the repo. DataStore.default() resolves src/civ_api/data/ at call time.
